$comment: The cardiac-arrest instrument's facility service. Vocabulary rule (SPEC 2b): this instrument is READINESS -- الجاهزية -- and never التأهب. Status labels (Current/Lapsing/Lapsed, the standing lines) are PROVISIONAL: the policy prescribes no status vocabulary and final labels await Ministry approval (policy 10, SPEC status note); provisionalNote renders on the Ministry cardiac configuration screen, the label-owner side, not on the operator record (partner ruling, second sweep). Mass-gathering outcome vocabulary never appears here.

$commentAudit20261008: Partner UI audit (2026-10-08): step 3 is one responsible contact; the AED record is lean (identifier, location, optional separate pin, accessibility, operational, pediatric, purpose, optional photo, facility confirmation); annual readiness confirmation and maintenance dates left the AED form; the plan shows the contact read-only and carries the facility confirmation. Existing alternate/emsGuide rows and device dates stay readable but are no longer collected or rendered.

site.$comment: FACILITY/SITE (owner decision, 9 October 2026, and the latest revision sections 1-15): Hosting Venue is removed as a regulatory entity and the Facility/Site is the single persistent place record. The Site ID is the anchor; the FC-nnnn record id stays as the registration reference. Statuses are PRODUCT-DEFINED operational labels (revision section 11), never the mass-gathering outcomes.
site.introEn: Register this Site if it belongs to a covered cardiac-readiness category. Registered Sites can also be reused when submitting Events held at the same location.
site.introAr: سجّلوا هذا الموقع إذا كان ينتمي إلى فئة مشمولة بالجاهزية لتوقف القلب. ويمكن أيضاً إعادة استخدام المواقع المسجّلة عند تقديم الفعاليات التي تُقام في المكان نفسه.

eventVenueCapacity.$comment: The event-hosting category's capacity threshold. The figure is the revision's own (section 1: 'an approved or licensed capacity of 1,000 persons or more'), held here as data like every other instrument threshold, and governed by a published Ministry value under configKey where one is in force. Removing minCapacity makes the threshold UNSET: the category then says so and covers nothing until the Ministry publishes one.

covered.en: Covered by its category. The rule applies automatically.

awaitingDesignation.en: No Ministry designation names this site. The category applies only once the Ministry records the designation.

thresholdUnset.ar: لم تنشر الوزارة عتبة السعة لهذه الفئة. ولا يسري شيء قبل نشرها؛ ويُبلَّغ المشغّلون عند نشرها.

evidence.statementEn: A third-party document is supporting evidence only. It does not itself establish MOPH acceptance or replace the regulatory Site requirements.
evidence.statementAr: المستند الصادر عن جهة ثالثة دليل داعم فقط. ولا يُثبت بحد ذاته قبول وزارة الصحة العامة ولا يحلّ محل المتطلبات التنظيمية للموقع.
evidence.$commentWording: Revision section 7 reads 'does not itself establish MOPH ap-proval'. That word is not platform vocabulary (CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 2), so the sentence reads 'MOPH acceptance' -- acceptance being the Ministry's own act on a site registration (revision section 11). Recorded for the owner.

evidence.$commentTypes: Revision section 7 lists one named program's documentation 'or equivalent'. Naming one program in a government picker is not vendor-neutral (revision section 18; CLAUDE.md 12), so the type reads 'External readiness program documentation'. Recorded for the owner.
